name: codex-1.0.0
description: Native interface to the OneMind Codex knowledge vault

tools.name: codex_capture
tools.description: Create a new note in the codex with proper frontmatter and template

domain.description: Target domain code (e.g. '08' for Infrastructure). Omit to put in inbox.

tools.name: codex_search
tools.description: Search the codex using tiered loading (L0 folder scan → L1 README + file list → L2 full read)

domain.description: Domain code to search within (e.g. '08'). Omit to search all.

level.description: How deep to search. Auto starts shallow, deepens as needed.

tools.name: codex_organize
tools.description: Move items from inbox to the correct 00-99 domain folder

file.description: Specific file path to organize (relative to codex root)

tools.name: codex_consolidate
tools.description: Merge scattered notes on a topic into one curated document

source_files.description: Specific files to consolidate (relative to codex root)

tools.name: codex_health
tools.description: Audit vault health: inbox overflow, orphans, missing frontmatter, broken links

tools.name: codex_tree
tools.description: Show codex folder structure at a given depth

path.description: Subfolder to list (relative to codex root). Omit for root.

depth.description: How many levels deep to show
